items.raw_excerpt: Walk down almost any market street in Bangkok and someone will offer to paint a tattoo on your arm in under ten minutes. It looks convincing for about a week, fades a little more with every shower, and is gone before your next paycheque.
items.summary_en: Walk down a market street in Bangkok and someone will paint a tattoo on your arm in under ten minutes. Real ink stays for years, but henna fades a little with every shower and is gone in about a week.
items.summary_ko: 방콕 시장 골목에서는 10분 만에 임시 문신을 그려 준다고 한다. 진짜 잉크는 몇 년이나 남지만 헤나 문신은 샤워할 때마다 옅어져 일주일쯤이면 사라진다.
items.title_en: Real ink or henna? What makes a tattoo last
items.title_ko: 속이는 건 진짜 잉크가 아니다: 무엇이 오래 남는가
items.title_original: Commitment is ink, not henna: what makes it last?

items.raw_excerpt: Universidade de Lisboa concentra 78.833 pessoas aptas a votar, em 207 seções espalhadas por três prédios do campus.
items.summary_en: About 78,800 students and staff at the University of Lisbon can vote in this year's election. They will vote in 207 polling stations inside three buildings on campus. No other single place in the country has as many voters.
items.summary_ko: 리스본대학교 학생과 교직원 약 7만8800명이 올해 투표할 수 있습니다. 투표는 캠퍼스 안 건물 세 곳에 마련된 207개 투표소에서 이뤄집니다. 전국에서 한곳에 모인 유권자가 가장 많은 곳입니다.
items.title_en: University of Lisbon has the biggest voter group in 2026
items.title_original: Universidade de Lisboa concentra maior número de eleitores em 2026

items.raw_excerpt: Pingo Doce has introduced a traditional marquise to its frozen range, giving chocolate lovers an easy dessert to share.
items.summary_en: Pingo Doce, a Portuguese chocolate shop chain, has put a traditional marquise dessert into its freezers. The frozen sweet costs 9.99 euros. The shop says it is an easy dessert to share with friends.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 초콜릿 가게 체인 핑고도체가 전통 마르키즈 디저트를 냉동 제품으로 내놓았다. 가격은 9.99유로이며 친구들과 나누어 먹기 좋은 디저트다.
items.title_en: Pingo Doce sells a frozen chocolate dessert for 9.99 euros
items.title_original: Pingo Doce launches chocolate dessert for €9.99 in Portugal

items.raw_excerpt: A British Columbia Supreme Court judge has ruled in favour of two harm-reduction activists convicted of drug trafficking who argued they were doing it to reduce the harms caused by toxic drugs.
items.summary_en: A judge in British Columbia has thrown out drug trafficking convictions for two men who ran a compassion club. This club gave drug users a safe place to use and test drugs. The two men told the court that they only wanted to reduce harm from toxic drugs, and the judge agreed with them.
items.summary_ko: 브리티시컬럼비아의 판사가 자비 클럽을 운영하던 두 사람의 약물 밀수 유죄를 뒤집었습니다. 이 클럽은 마약 사용자에게 안전한 장소와 약물 검사 기회를 제공했습니다. 두 사람은 독성 있는 약물이 만드는 해를 줄이려던 것이라고 법정에서 말했고 판사는 그 주장을 받아들였습니다.
items.title_en: Judge drops drug charges against two B.C. club founders
items.title_ko: judge's ruling clears two B.C. compassion club founders
items.title_original: Judge tosses drug trafficking convictions for B.C. compassion club founders after constitutional challenge

items.raw_excerpt: Rhonda Zielinski is a frontline worker in New Zealand’s fight against meth, and she can be brutally honest.
items.summary_en: Rhonda Zielinski works on the front line of New Zealand's fight against meth. She says relapse is a normal part of getting better. She is open about her own hard journey.
items.summary_ko: 론다 지엘린스키는 뉴질랜드의 메트 밀수 근원에 맞서 싸우는 현장 실무자다. 그녀는 재발은 나아가는 과정의 정상적인 단계라고 말한다. 그녀는 자신이 겪어온 힘든 과정을 솔직하게 꺼낸다.
items.title_en: Relapse Is Part of Recovery: The Fight Against Meth
items.title_original: 'Relapse is a part of recovery': the round-the-clock fight against meth

items.raw_excerpt: Which aircraft is currently used on the Qantas non-stop flight from Perth to London? And which Australian artist is known for his paintings of Sydney Harbour?
items.summary_en: This is a travel quiz for late September. It asks questions about popular destinations and famous sights. Try it and see how many places you can name.

items.raw_excerpt: For more than four years, American Bill Delzell has been trying to figure out the identity of the photographer who captured San Francisco history in the 1960s. Now he's hoping a Sask. company will be able to develop 75 rolls of unprocessed film to crack the mystery.
items.summary_en: Bill Delzell has spent four years trying to find the photographer who took pictures of San Francisco in the 1960s. He sent 75 unopened rolls of film to a small photo shop in Saskatchewan. The shop will develop the film so he can see what the pictures show.
items.summary_ko: 빌 델젤관은1960년대 샌프란시스크를 촬영한 사진작가를 알아내기 위해 4년째 hunt하고 있다. 그는 미개봉 필름 57통을 캐나다 사스케이체방의 작은 사진관에 맡겼다. 사진관이 필름을 현상하면 사진 내용을 확인해 볼 수 있다.
items.title_en: A small photo shop in Saskatchewan helps solve a 1960s San Francisco mystery
items.title_ko: 캐나다 소규모 사진관에서 1960년대 샌프란시스코 미스터리 푸는 중
items.title_original: American taps small Sask. business to solve international photo mystery

items.raw_excerpt: CBC News breaks down each of the referendum questions to help voters prepare to mark the 10 ballots.
items.summary_en: Alberta will hold a referendum with 10 questions on October 19. Voters will mark 10 ballots. CBC News explains what each question is about.
items.summary_ko: 앨버타는 10월 19일에 10개 질문으로 된 주민투표를 진행한다. 유권자는 투표용지 10장을 표시하게 된다. CBC 뉴스 각 질문의 내용을 자세히 알려준다.

items.raw_excerpt: Ferran Soriano fue increpado por el reportero Rob Harris tras el dictamen de la Premier League sobre las irregularidades económicas del club.
items.summary_en: A reporter asked Manchester City executive Ferran Soriano whether his club was real. The question came after a Premier League ruling about the club's financial irregularities. The sharp tone made Soriano angry, and the clip spread online.
